committee: Joint Travel, Recreation, Wildlife & Cultural Resources
title: The purpose of this meeting is to complete the Committee's interim work. The Committee will receive testimony and consider bill drafts concerning: (1) event ticket resales; (2) nonmotorized recreational trail fees; (3) authorization for the Wyoming State Museum to charge fees; (4) the creation of a commercial fishing guide board; and (5) funding for the Game and Fish Department and other trust funds.
